rows.note: This is the all-purpose adverbial for describing something in terms of its psychological aspect or effect.

example.english: This breakup made them psychologically much more mature.
example.traditional: 呢次失戀令佢心理上成熟咗好多。
example.jyutping: ni1 ci3 sat1 lyun2 ling6 keoi5 sam1 lei5 soeng6 sing4 suk6 zo2 hou2 do1

rows.jyutping: jung6 sam1 lei5 hok6 heoi3 V
rows.note: Use this when someone actively applies psychology to analyse, interpret, or explain something.

example.english: In counselling, you can't just listen to the surface; you have to psychologically analyse why they think that way.
example.traditional: 做輔導唔可以淨係聽表面，要用心理學去分析佢點解咁諗。
example.jyutping: zou6 fu6 dou6 m4 ho2 ji5 zing6 hai6 teng1 biu2 min6 jiu3 jung6 sam1 lei5 hok6 heoi3 fan1 sik1 keoi5 dim2 gaai2 gam3 nam2
